status: eight partial method interfaces; whole family curation still in progress

methods.label: lem:next-pin
methods.title: 条件下一钉均值
methods.input: A finite admissible unconditioned permutation law on I disjoint union D; K is its column-forward mean.
methods.output: Unnormalized next-pin determinant identity; if Pr(all cycles hit I)>0 and I nonempty, E[Sigma|all-hit]=KII+KID(I-KDD)^-1 KDI.
conditions: Admissibility is a limit of independent Bernoulli transpositions and deterministic permutations.
Positive all-hit probability is required for conditional expectation and inverse; the unnormalized polynomial identity also covers zero probability.
methods.cannot_transfer: Only a conditional first moment is identified. Full paths are not independent fresh Markov paths; the conditioned permutation need not retain exterior-moment closure.
methods.old_baseline: DLM2020 all-minor preservation/independent products is an old baseline; the all-hit bridge needs its separate identity.

methods.label: lem:capacity
methods.title: 双方向残差到容量误差
methods.input: A finite nonnegative doubly substochastic U with killed coordinates, an unkilled point i, and trial h with h(i)=1 and h=0 on killing.
methods.output: For the probability q of a positive-step return to i before killing, |q-(1-c)|<=|<h,mu+>|+2X^2+2epsilon.
conditions: Counting measure and column-forward U. Real c; ||h||infinity<=M.
There are X,epsilon>=0 with |<mu_d,z>|<=X sqrt(<z,(I-U)z>)+epsilon for BOTH d=+,- and EVERY real z vanishing on K with ||z||infinity<=1+M.
methods.cannot_transfer: A scalar residual alone is insufficient. Inaccessible closed classes are allowed. This gives neither a new fast solver nor practical error constants without constructing the dual certificate.
methods.old_baseline: Gaudilliere-Landim nonreversible potential theory and direct finite harmonic linear algebra are old baselines, with different stationary/irreducibility interfaces.

methods.label: lem:torus-flow-pairing
methods.title: 环面截流与残差配对
methods.input: Sparse source centers, subunit nonnegative masses supported in regular lifted balls B_A, and a torus L sufficiently large relative to A.
methods.output: A source pairing is bounded by sqrt(C m A^alpha) sqrt(Dirichlet energy)+C m L^(1/2-k)||Y||2, k=199/100.
conditions: Regularity is the deterministic lifted-hole condition.
Keep the cutoff divergence error; the later absorption uses ghost killing energy >=q||Y||2^2.
methods.cannot_transfer: An infinite unit-source flow cannot simply become a sink-free finite-torus flow. Dropping the divergence error changes the statement. Constants and thresholds are model dependent.
methods.old_baseline: Classical flow-energy and Cauchy-Schwarz bounds remain baselines; no routing runtime improvement has been measured.

methods.label: lem:skeleton-graph
methods.title: 迹界控制小封闭类
methods.input: The source exposure skeleton graph Gamma, row-stochastic and column-stochastic K closed on its components, w=1-q in (0,1), D=I-wK.
methods.output: Each closed component contributes at least 1/q to Tr D^-1; the soft-pin trace estimate yields E[number of components]<=q N.
conditions: The source endpoint/contact graph and soft-pin weighted law are required.
The bound E Tr D^-1<=N is an additional source identity, not automatic for every stochastic K.
methods.cannot_transfer: Does not assume irreducibility, reversibility or large classes. It does not assert a component bound for an arbitrary graph lacking the trace estimate.
methods.old_baseline: Finite stochastic-block eigenvalue and resolvent identities are the old linear-algebra baseline.

methods.label: lem:strip-curvature
methods.title: 条带零点条件下的曲率传播
methods.input: Holomorphic F in |Im z|<a0, real/even on R, F(0)=0, 0<=F(x)<=K|x| and Re F(x+iy)<=F(x).
methods.output: A positive convolution representation of Fsecond gives 0<=Fsecond(x)<=exp(2pi|x|/a) Fsecond(0), and the integrated exponential bound on F.
conditions: All strip, growth and positivity assumptions apply; the source argument localizes in frequency before using its Schwartz multiplier.
methods.cannot_transfer: Ordinary spectral Laplace variance is not Duhamel covariance. No universal concentration statement follows for data with unverified zero-free strip.
methods.old_baseline: Classical complex analysis and exponential Markov bounds remain the comparison route; the strip width must be supplied.

methods.label: lem:trace-zero-free
methods.title: 严格单槽收缩到循环迹非零
methods.input: Finite cyclic product with at least one admissible mean-permutation layer and intervening tensor single-slot matrices.
methods.output: The complete cyclic trace is nonzero when each intervening slot map sends the closed unit disk strictly into the open disk with nonvanishing coordinate factor.
conditions: The projective coordinate must remain defined on the closed disk.
Every slot between successive permutation layers satisfies the strict mapping condition.
methods.cannot_transfer: Samplewise nonzero traces do not imply their average is nonzero. Arbitrary complex insertions or non-strict boundary maps are not admitted.
methods.old_baseline: Asano/Ruelle contraction antecedents remain an unqualified historical interface here; not an invented new zero-free theorem.

methods.label: lem:pin-mixture
methods.title: 用压力增量保留极限顺序
methods.input: Finite-volume positive-field pressure, the actual posterior mixture of extra pins and uniform pin estimates.
methods.output: Integrate finite-volume derivative bounds before volume and field limits; then fixed-K low-temperature estimates can be passed to the K limit in their stated order.
conditions: Posterior pin mixing is not an independent product law.
Keep N->infinity, right field->0, beta->infinity at fixed K, then K->infinity.
methods.cannot_transfer: Zero-field free-energy asymptotics alone cannot be differentiated in an unexamined field. A fixed-K little-o is not an effective uniform-in-K finite-temperature error.
methods.old_baseline: CGS2015 zero-field free energy is a qualified older interface, not already a field-derivative magnetization conclusion.

methods.label: lem:harmonic-selection
methods.title: 由样本矩选择调和对数
methods.input: Almost surely nonzero holomorphic random F_n in the right half-plane, T_n->infinity, locally Lipschitz s and a dense set of positive real points.
methods.output: Matching exponential product first/second moments and the locally uniform second-moment upper bound select a harmonic v with v(x)=s(x) and v(z)<=s(Re z).
conditions: All finite dense-point products need the stated moment limits.
Nonvanishing is samplewise and logarithmic normalization is T_n.
methods.cannot_transfer: An existence selection does not supply a practical sampler, a success probability bound for finite budgets, or zero-freeness of the average.
methods.old_baseline: Paley-Zygmund, submean estimates and Harnack compactness form the classical comparison ingredients; no computational advantage is inferred.
